narration: In 1964, a high school student named Randy made a bet with his friends. He would try to break the world record for staying awake.
visual_prompt: a cartoon stickman teenager grinning and holding up a big round alarm clock while two stickman friends cheer around a table with a wall calendar behind them
prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman teenager grinning and holding up a big round alarm clock while two stickman friends cheer around a table with a wall calendar behind them

narration: No coffee tricks, no alarms, no help. Just a teenager, a calendar, and a very bad idea.
visual_prompt: a cartoon stickman character standing proudly in an empty room with hands on hips, a calendar on the wall and a large ticking stopwatch floating beside its head
prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman character standing proudly in an empty room with hands on hips, a calendar on the wall and a large ticking stopwatch floating beside its head

narration: It started as a science fair project. For the first two days he felt completely fine. He played basketball outside, he joked with his friends, he felt like a superhero.
visual_prompt: a cartoon stickman teenager happily shooting a basketball on an outdoor court under a yellow sun, big confident smile, motion lines on the ball
prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman teenager happily shooting a basketball on an outdoor court under a yellow sun, big confident smile, motion lines on the ball

narration: But scientists at a nearby hospital heard about the attempt, and they decided to follow him around the clock. With clipboards. So many clipboards.
visual_prompt: two cartoon stickman scientists in white coats holding clipboards and pens, following a third stickman teenager who looks slightly nervous, simple street background
prompt: ckstyle, two cartoon stickman scientists in white coats holding clipboards and pens, following a third stickman teenager who looks slightly nervous, simple street background

narration: On day three, the jokes stopped being funny. By day four, simple things became hard. He stood in front of the open refrigerator and forgot why he walked into the kitchen.
visual_prompt: a cartoon stickman teenager standing in front of an open refrigerator with a blank confused expression and a question mark above its head, simple kitchen at night
prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman teenager standing in front of an open refrigerator with a blank confused expression and a question mark above its head, simple kitchen at night

narration: On day five, his eyes stopped focusing properly. The world went slightly soft and blurry, like someone smeared grease on a camera lens.
visual_prompt: a cartoon stickman teenager squinting and rubbing one eye at a coffee mug drawn with wavy blurry outlines on a table, confused expression, simple room
prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman teenager squinting and rubbing one eye at a coffee mug drawn with wavy blurry outlines on a table, confused expression, simple room

narration: And then the strange things started. A road sign at the corner looked like a person standing very, very still. He knew it was a sign. He stared at it anyway.
visual_prompt: a cartoon stickman teenager on a sidewalk staring suspiciously at a simple road sign on a pole, the shadow of the sign shaped like a standing person, uneasy expression
prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman teenager on a sidewalk staring suspiciously at a simple road sign on a pole, the shadow of the sign shaped like a standing person, uneasy expression

narration: His mood fell apart. A friend made one small joke and Randy snapped at him like he had been stung. Sleep debt is not polite.
visual_prompt: a cartoon stickman teenager with an angry puffed face talking to a laughing stickman friend, small red frustration lines around its head, sidewalk background
prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman teenager with an angry puffed face talking to a laughing stickman friend, small red frustration lines around its head, sidewalk background

narration: The doctors tested his memory. Count backwards from one hundred by sevens, they said. He made it to sixty-five. Then he stopped, and could not remember what he was doing.
visual_prompt: a cartoon stickman teenager sitting at a table facing two doctors in white coats, thought bubble showing the numbers 100, 93, 86 and then a big question mark
prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman teenager sitting at a table facing two doctors in white coats, thought bubble showing the numbers 100, 93, 86 and then a big question mark

narration: Worse were the microsleeps. His eyes stayed open, but his brain quietly shut down for two or three seconds. He never knew when it would happen.
visual_prompt: a cartoon stickman teenager walking on a sidewalk with eyes closed and body swaying, a large wall clock beside it showing a hand ticking seconds, microsleep moment
prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman teenager walking on a sidewalk with eyes closed and body swaying, a large wall clock beside it showing a hand ticking seconds, microsleep moment

narration: In the lab, the brain wave monitor told the truth. Even while he was walking around wide awake, tiny fragments of sleep were sneaking into his brain behind his back.
visual_prompt: a cartoon stickman teenager lying on a lab bed with small round sensors on its head, a monitor next to it showing a wavy squiggly line, two scientists watching
prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman teenager lying on a lab bed with small round sensors on its head, a monitor next to it showing a wavy squiggly line, two scientists watching

narration: On day nine he picked up a newspaper and could not finish reading one single headline. For one scary moment, his own name felt unfamiliar.
visual_prompt: a cartoon stickman teenager holding a giant newspaper with a shocked open-mouth expression, blurred squiggly lines instead of text on the page, simple room
prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman teenager holding a giant newspaper with a shocked open-mouth expression, blurred squiggly lines instead of text on the page, simple room

narration: Then, on day eleven, two hundred and sixty-four hours after this whole thing started, he finally stopped. The record was broken.
visual_prompt: a cartoon stickman teenager on a stage holding up a golden trophy with both hands, confetti falling, a large calendar behind with eleven days crossed off with red x marks
prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman teenager on a stage holding up a golden trophy with both hands, confetti falling, a large calendar behind with eleven days crossed off with red x marks

narration: When he finally went to bed, he slept for fourteen straight hours. And when he woke up, the doctors checked him from head to toe. No permanent damage at all.

prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman sleeping peacefully in bed under a pale blue blanket with three Z letters floating up, a small golden trophy on the nightstand, dark window

narration: His body simply collected every hour of sleep it was owed, and moved on like nothing happened.

prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman doctor in a white coat giving a big thumbs up beside a happy stickman teenager standing with arms open, bright simple clinic room

narration: But here is the part that should keep YOU up at night. After just one night without sleep, your reaction time drops like a phone with one percent battery.

prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman character trying to catch a glass tumbling off a table with one hand arriving too late, motion lines, wide worried eyes, simple kitchen

narration: So if you are lying awake right now, scrolling on your phone in the dark, think of Randy and the road sign that looked like a person. Put the phone down.

prompt: ckstyle, a cartoon stickman teenager lying in bed at night looking at a glowing phone screen with tired half-closed eyes, dark bedroom, red digital clock on nightstand

narration: Because the record he set still stands today. Not because nobody could break it, but because after Randy, nobody was ever allowed to try again.
